verdict.rationale: Advertising approval or success rates is a fair question for an immigration law firm, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no advertised approval or success rate at all, and no case counts, time windows, or methodology. The pricing, service, and parole-threshold pages cover fees and eligibility, not outcome statistics, so there is no evidence the firm delivers this story.

support.subject: As a founder, any advertised approval or success rate comes with a stated basis — case counts, time window, or methodology — on the provider's own pages
